w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Redactor mauled Feng (-64 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: It's settled. The village is calling it "Old Gavel." The Codex keeps it.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Spool mauled Ethan (-61 health) over 6 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: A frame of it hangs in the air. Then another. It's buffering.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sanne just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
tiger is hurt — and it goes quiet and clever. It stops rushing. It starts CHOOSING. Watch the spacing.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🗣️ Sanne to Diana, by the fire: "119 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."
A curious wanderer waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

windowEndGuard: not-ready:Finish the current encounter before taking your seat.
auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/12/9), with 7 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Rafael Torres ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
